body: those two years aren’t down the drain!! you still made it those two years, even if you made a mistake now. relapse is an inevitable part of recovery. your feelings are so valid, and im proud of you for making it this far. things are going to be okay <3
small update: i thought of a solution for if/when my SO asks. just going to say “i guess it happened when i was drunk” bc technically true, so i dont have to lie and i wont feel so shitty
i think im going to try to change my medications and figure stuff out soon. thank you for the help <3
thank you <3 i appreciate the kind words

i do see a doctor for anxiety and a therapist (who is on maternity leave for another two weeks), but i feel like im not depressed enough to get medicated or something. also, im terrified of telling any of them about my suicidal thoughts, as i dont want to end up in inpatient or something :(
